native_result.HypoB: All 18 original studies in the Experimental Economics (EERP) replication project were conducted in a lab setting: every study has online.o = 0 (i.e., not conducted online), so the proportion of studies in Experimental Economics conducted in a lab setting is 18/18 = 100%.
